genetic.notes: Health-insurance carriers may not use genetic information for eligibility or pricing. Life / long-term-care / disability insurance is not federally covered but many states restrict.

health.legal_basis: ACA §1201 (community rating for individual / small-group health insurance)
health.notes: ACA forbids health-status rating for health insurance. Allowed in life / disability with disclosure.

ethnicity.legal_basis: Unfair Trade Practices Acts (state); FHA (housing-related insurance)

gender.legal_basis: ACA §1557 (sex non-discrimination for health insurance); auto/life vary by state

credit_score.legal_basis: State insurance laws (varies; banned in CA, MA, HI for auto)

postcode.notes: Auto-insurance redlining concerns; some states (e.g. CA Prop 103) restrict territorial rating.
